wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Vegetation Near Structure; Scattered Shrubs; Open Green Space; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Multiple Access Routes; Large Trees
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees within the cluster nearest to the structure to create more open space between individual trees.
• Trim lower branches on large trees close to the structure to reduce the path fire can take from the ground up into the tree canopy.
• Remove or cut back shrubs that are directly touching or leaning against the structure.
• Separate scattered shrubs from one another where they grow in close groups near the structure to reduce connected burning material.
• Keep the area directly around the structure clear of dry leaves, loose plant material, and dead debris that collect against walls and under decks.
• Trim overhanging branches from large trees that extend directly over the roof or chimney area.
• Keep both access routes clear of low-hanging branches and overgrown vegetation along the edges so vehicles can move through without obstruction.
• Remove dead wood and dry plant debris from within the tree cluster closest to the structure.
